title: Uniformity in rational torsion and small points on abelian varieties
summary: In this paper, we propose a method to study the {\it Uniform Boundedness Conjecture} and the {\it Lang-Silverman Conjecture} for abelian varieties $A$ defined over a global field $K$; the latter is a uniform lower bound on the heights of non-torsion rational points. Our method is inspired by Vojta's proof of the Mordell Conjecture (Faltings's Theorem). Over function fields of characteristic $0$, a recent breakthrough of Looper-Yap (arXiv:2603.23396) proves both conjectures with inexplicit bounds.
